lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gills, with the central row maintaining the highest spatial density and peak intensity values.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows, particularly in the mid-flank region, creating a discernible grid of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral boundary, defined by a sharp luminance transition from a light-reflective upper edge to a high-contrast shadow immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; secondary irregular margins are observed on the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and posterior to the pectoral fin base.
